name: Greek Words 101–200
description: Common Greek nouns, pronouns, adjectives and adverbs, numbers 101–200 on the frequency list. Nouns come with their article, plural and genitive; adjectives with their feminine and neuter forms.

cards.definition: The hair that grows on your head.

examples.text: Πρέπει να κόψω τα μαλλιά μου.
examples.translation: I need to get my hair cut.

cards.notes: Plural in Greek, singular in English.

cards.definition: The whole physical structure of a person or animal.

examples.text: Η γιόγκα κάνει καλό στο σώμα.
examples.translation: Yoga is good for the body.

cards.definition: The red liquid that flows through the body.
The sound a person makes when speaking or singing.

examples.text: Μη μιλάς με τόσο δυνατή φωνή.

cards.notes: Οι φωνές also means shouting.

cards.definition: The things someone says; the words of a song.

examples.translation: Do you know the lyrics of the song?

cards.notes: A plural of ο λόγος, used for spoken words. A single dictionary word is η λέξη.

cards.definition: A system of words used by a people; also the tongue in your mouth.

examples.translation: How many languages do you speak?

cards.definition: A set of printed pages bound together for reading.
A sign used in writing; also a written message sent to someone.
Thin material for writing or printing on.

examples.text: Έχεις ένα χαρτί και ένα στυλό;
examples.translation: Do you have a piece of paper and a pen?

cards.notes: Τα χαρτιά = playing cards; also documents, papers. Χαρτί υγείας = toilet paper.

cards.definition: A picture or image; also a religious icon.

examples.text: Η εικόνα στην τηλεόραση δεν είναι καθαρή.
examples.translation: The picture on the TV isn't clear.
There are many icons in the church.

cards.definition: A story told with moving pictures.

examples.text: Πάμε σινεμά να δούμε μια ταινία;
examples.translation: Shall we go to the cinema to see a film?

cards.notes: Also a strip or tape.

cards.definition: Sounds arranged in a pleasant way, played or sung.

examples.translation: I listen to music when I work.

cards.definition: A short piece of music with words.

examples.text: Μου αρέσει πολύ αυτό το τραγούδι.
Τραγουδήσαμε ελληνικά τραγούδια όλη τη νύχτα.
examples.translation: We sang Greek songs all night.

cards.definition: Something you play, or a thing children play with.

examples.translation: The children are playing a game.

cards.definition: An account of events; the study of the past.
A place where children are taught.

examples.text: Τα παιδιά πάνε σχολείο στις οχτώ.
examples.translation: The children go to school at eight.

examples.text: Το σχολείο είναι κοντά στο σπίτι μας.
examples.translation: The school is near our house.

cards.definition: A period of teaching; a subject studied at school.

examples.translation: I have a Greek lesson every Tuesday.

examples.text: Ποιο είναι το αγαπημένο σου μάθημα;

cards.definition: A person who teaches, especially young children.

examples.text: Η δασκάλα μάς διάβασε μια ιστορία.
examples.translation: The teacher read us a story.

cards.notes: For secondary school and university: ο καθηγητής / η καθηγήτρια.

cards.definition: A child or young person who goes to school.
cards.notes: A university student is ο φοιτητής / η φοιτήτρια.

cards.definition: A person studying at a university.

examples.translation: I'm a student at the University of Athens.

examples.text: Πολλοί φοιτητές μένουν σε αυτή τη γειτονιά.
examples.translation: Many students live in this neighbourhood.

cards.definition: A place of higher education and research.

examples.text: Το πανεπιστήμιο είναι κλειστό τον Αύγουστο.
examples.translation: The university is closed in August.

cards.definition: A teacher at a secondary school, or a university professor.

examples.text: Ο καθηγητής μου των μαθηματικών είναι πολύ καλός.
examples.translation: My maths teacher is very good.
She's a professor at the university.

cards.definition: A person trained to treat sick people.

examples.translation: You should go to the doctor.

examples.text: Η γιατρός μού έδωσε ένα φάρμακο.
examples.translation: The doctor gave me some medicine.

cards.notes: The same word is used for a woman, with the feminine article: η γιατρός.

cards.definition: A place where sick or injured people are treated.
Something you take to treat an illness.

examples.text: Αυτό το φάρμακο είναι για τον βήχα.

cards.notes: Το φαρμακείο = pharmacy.

cards.definition: An unpleasant feeling in part of the body.
cards.notes: Πονάω = to hurt. Ο πονοκέφαλος = headache.

cards.definition: The condition of your body and mind.

examples.text: Η υγεία είναι το πιο σημαντικό.
examples.translation: Health is the most important thing.

examples.text: Πρέπει να προσέχεις την υγεία σου.
examples.translation: You must take care of your health.

cards.notes: Στην υγειά μας! = Cheers! (spelled υγειά in this phrase).

cards.definition: A disease or period of being ill.
cards.notes: The adjective is άρρωστος = ill, sick.

cards.definition: Things that people eat; also a cooked meal.

examples.translation: Shall we go out to eat?

cards.definition: A basic food made from flour and baked.

examples.translation: Can you pass me some bread?

cards.definition: The flesh of animals eaten as food.

examples.text: Το κρέας θέλει ακόμα λίγο ψήσιμο.
examples.translation: The meat needs a bit more cooking.

cards.definition: An animal that lives in water; also its meat as food.

examples.translation: We saw lots of fish in the sea.

cards.definition: The white liquid produced by cows and other animals.

examples.translation: Do you take your coffee with milk?

examples.text: Πήγαινε να πάρεις γάλα, σε παρακαλώ.
examples.translation: Go and get some milk, please.

cards.definition: A hot or cold drink made from roasted coffee beans.

examples.translation: Shall we go for a coffee?
A Greek coffee with medium sugar, please.

cards.notes: Greek coffee comes σκέτος (no sugar), μέτριος (medium) or γλυκός (sweet).

cards.definition: A hot drink made by soaking leaves in water.

examples.translation: Would you like tea or coffee?

examples.text: Πίνω τσάι του βουνού όταν κρυώνω.
examples.translation: I drink mountain tea when I have a cold.

cards.notes: Τσάι του βουνού = Greek mountain tea.

cards.definition: An alcoholic drink made from grapes.

examples.translation: A glass of red wine, please.

examples.text: Το κρασί της Σαντορίνης είναι πολύ καλό.

cards.notes: Κόκκινο / λευκό κρασί = red / white wine.

cards.definition: A sweet part of a plant that you can eat, such as an apple.

examples.text: Ποιο είναι το αγαπημένο σου φρούτο;

cards.definition: A plant or part of a plant eaten as food, such as a carrot.

examples.translation: I buy vegetables at the street market.

cards.notes: Usually plural. Η λαϊκή = the weekly street market.

cards.definition: A sweet substance used in food and drinks.

examples.translation: Do you take sugar in your coffee?

cards.definition: A white substance used to flavour food.

examples.text: Δώσε μου το αλάτι, σε παρακαλώ.

examples.translation: The soup needs a little salt.

cards.definition: A piece of furniture with a flat top and legs.

examples.translation: The food is on the table.
I booked a table for four.

cards.notes: Στρώνω το τραπέζι = I set the table.

cards.definition: A seat for one person, with a back.
A piece of furniture for sleeping on.
A space in a building with its own walls and door.

examples.translation: Do you have a free room?

cards.notes: Ενοικιάζονται δωμάτια = rooms to let (a common sign).

cards.definition: The room where food is cooked; a style of cooking; a stove.

examples.text: Μου αρέσει πολύ η ελληνική κουζίνα.

cards.definition: An opening in a wall with glass in it.

examples.translation: I always sit by the window.

cards.definition: A shaped piece of metal for opening a lock.

examples.text: Ξέχασα το κλειδί μέσα στο σπίτι.
examples.translation: I left the key inside the house.

cards.definition: A device for talking to people far away; also a call.
cards.notes: Παίρνω τηλέφωνο = to phone someone.

cards.definition: An electronic machine for storing and processing information.

examples.translation: I work at the computer all day.

examples.text: Ο υπολογιστής μου είναι πολύ αργός.

cards.notes: Φορητός υπολογιστής = laptop (also το λάπτοπ).

cards.definition: A road vehicle with an engine for a few passengers.

examples.translation: I parked the car on the corner.

cards.notes: In everyday speech also το αμάξι.

cards.definition: A vehicle with two wheels that you pedal.

examples.text: Έμαθα να κάνω ποδήλατο στα πέντε μου.
examples.translation: I learned to ride a bike when I was five.

cards.notes: Κάνω ποδήλατο = to ride a bike.

cards.definition: A large road vehicle that carries many passengers.
A row of carriages pulled along a railway.

examples.text: Το τρένο για τη Θεσσαλονίκη φεύγει στις οχτώ.
examples.translation: The train to Thessaloniki leaves at eight.

cards.definition: A flying vehicle with wings and engines.

examples.text: Το αεροπλάνο προσγειώθηκε στην ώρα του.

cards.definition: A large boat that carries people or goods by sea.

examples.text: Το πλοίο για τη Νάξο φεύγει από τον Πειραιά.
examples.translation: The ferry to Naxos leaves from Piraeus.

examples.text: Ταξιδέψαμε όλη τη νύχτα με το πλοίο.
examples.translation: We travelled all night on the ship.

cards.notes: In everyday speech also το καράβι.

cards.definition: Travelling from one place to another.
The large body of salt water that covers much of the earth.

examples.text: Το καλοκαίρι πάμε για θάλασσα κάθε μέρα.
examples.translation: In summer we go swimming in the sea every day.

cards.notes: Πάω για θάλασσα = I'm going to the beach for a swim.

cards.definition: A very high hill.

examples.text: Ο Όλυμπος είναι το ψηλότερο βουνό της Ελλάδας.
examples.translation: Olympus is the highest mountain in Greece.
In winter we go to the mountains.

cards.definition: A large natural stream of water.

examples.text: Το χωριό είναι δίπλα σε ένα ποτάμι.
examples.translation: The village is next to a river.

cards.notes: More formal: ο ποταμός.

cards.definition: A tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches.

examples.text: Το χριστουγεννιάτικο δέντρο είναι στο σαλόνι.
examples.translation: The Christmas tree is in the living room.

cards.definition: The coloured part of a plant.

examples.translation: The garden is full of flowers.

cards.definition: The space above the earth where you see the sun and clouds.

examples.translation: Look at the stars in the sky!

cards.definition: The star that gives the earth light and heat.

examples.text: Καθίσαμε στον ήλιο όλο το απόγευμα.
examples.translation: We sat in the sun all afternoon.

cards.definition: The object that circles the earth and shines at night.

examples.text: Το φεγγάρι είναι πολύ φωτεινό απόψε.
examples.translation: The moon is very bright tonight.

examples.text: Είδαμε το φεγγάρι να βγαίνει πάνω από τη θάλασσα.
examples.translation: We watched the moon rise over the sea.

cards.notes: Full moon = η πανσέληνος. Formal: η σελήνη.

cards.definition: A point of light in the night sky; also a famous person.

examples.translation: You can see lots of stars tonight.
He's the star of the team.

cards.definition: Flames and heat from something burning.

examples.translation: We lit a fire on the beach.

cards.notes: A large fire or wildfire is η πυρκαγιά (formal).

cards.definition: The gas we breathe; moving air, wind.

examples.text: Πάμε έξω να πάρουμε λίγο αέρα.
examples.translation: Let's go out and get some fresh air.

cards.definition: Water falling from clouds.
cards.notes: Βρέχει = it's raining.

cards.definition: The conditions outside (sun, rain, wind); also a period of time.

examples.translation: I haven't seen you for ages!

cards.notes: Έχω καιρό να… = it's been a long time since I….

cards.definition: The planet we live on; land, soil.

examples.text: Η Γη γυρίζει γύρω από τον ήλιο.
examples.translation: The Earth goes round the sun.

examples.text: Αυτή η γη είναι πολύ εύφορη.

cards.notes: Usually no plural. The planet is written with a capital: η Γη.

cards.definition: What makes things visible, from the sun or a lamp.

examples.translation: Turn off the lights before you leave.

cards.notes: Irregular: plural τα φώτα, genitive του φωτός.

cards.definition: Red, blue, green and so on.

examples.text: Τι χρώμα είναι το αυτοκίνητό σου;

cards.definition: A living creature that is not a plant or a person.
cards.notes: Κατοικίδιο ζώο = pet.

cards.definition: A common four-legged animal kept as a pet.

examples.text: Βγάζω βόλτα τον σκύλο κάθε πρωί.
examples.translation: I take the dog for a walk every morning.

cards.notes: Also το σκυλί.

cards.definition: A small furry animal often kept as a pet.

examples.translation: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
There are lots of cats on the islands.

cards.definition: An animal with feathers and wings.

examples.translation: A bird is sitting on the balcony.

cards.definition: Not high; close to the ground.
cards.notes: Opposite: ψηλός.

cards.definition: Pleasant to look at or to experience.
cards.notes: Ωραία! on its own = Great! / Fine!

cards.definition: Very pleasant to look at.
Unpleasant to look at; not good.
cards.notes: Adverb: άσχημα = badly. Νιώθω άσχημα = I feel bad.

cards.definition: Not new; from long ago.

examples.translation: We live in an old house.
He's an old friend of mine.

cards.notes: For a person's age, use μεγάλος or ηλικιωμένος (elderly).

cards.definition: Not interesting.
cards.notes: Βαριέμαι = I'm bored.

cards.definition: Having great value or effect.

examples.translation: I have an important meeting tomorrow.

cards.definition: Not easy to do or understand.

examples.text: Τα ελληνικά δεν είναι τόσο δύσκολα.

cards.notes: Adverb: δύσκολα = with difficulty.

cards.definition: Not difficult.

examples.text: Δεν είναι εύκολο να βρεις σπίτι στην Αθήνα.
examples.translation: It isn't easy to find a place to live in Athens.

cards.definition: Having power; making a lot of sound; able to happen.
cards.notes: Είναι δυνατόν; = Is it possible? Adverb: δυνατά = loudly.

cards.definition: Without mistakes; suitable.
cards.notes: Σωστά! = Right! / Exactly! "You're right" is έχεις δίκιο.

cards.definition: Something that is not correct.
cards.notes: Before another noun it works like an adjective that never changes: λάθος δρόμος = wrong road. Κατά λάθος = by mistake.

cards.definition: Based on facts; not fake.
cards.notes: Η αλήθεια = the truth.

cards.definition: Not real; made to look like something else.

examples.translation: He gave me a false name.

cards.notes: Το ψέμα = a lie.

cards.definition: Not controlled or busy; not taken.
cards.notes: Also "single" (not in a relationship). Free of charge is δωρεάν.

cards.definition: Containing as much as possible.

examples.translation: The glass is full of water.

cards.notes: Γεμάτος + noun = full of. Opposite: άδειος.

cards.definition: Containing nothing.

examples.text: Οι δρόμοι είναι άδειοι τον Αύγουστο.
examples.translation: The streets are empty in August.

cards.notes: Opposite: γεμάτος.

cards.definition: Having a high temperature.
cards.notes: For the weather, use the noun: κάνει ζέστη = it's hot.

cards.definition: Having a low temperature.
cards.notes: For the weather: κάνει κρύο = it's cold. Κρυώνω = I'm cold.

cards.definition: Not dirty; easy to see through or understand.

examples.text: Το νερό είναι πολύ καθαρό εδώ.
examples.translation: The water is very clear here.

cards.notes: Καθαρίζω = to clean.

cards.definition: Not clean.

examples.translation: Don't sit on the dirty floor.

cards.notes: Also spelled βρώμικος.

cards.definition: Of great height.

examples.text: Ο αδερφός μου είναι πολύ ψηλός.

examples.translation: We live in a tall building.

cards.notes: Opposite: κοντός (short) or χαμηλός (low).

cards.definition: Not tall or long.
cards.notes: The adverb κοντά means near.

cards.definition: Measuring a lot from one end to the other; lasting a long time.
cards.notes: The adverb μακριά (spelled like the feminine) means far away.
